## RoutedProviders type

The providers `Ps` as the routes `R` let them be asked for base rows of the entities `Bases`<!-- -->: each as it is given, or, for one no route reaches from one of them, why not (<!-- -->\`<!-- -->provider "credits" has no route from "artist"<!-- -->\`<!-- -->), which the compiler shows where it refuses the call. Bases not known (`string`<!-- -->, rows built at run time) ask only that some route reaches the provider; an id not known (`string`<!-- -->, a field picker's) asks nothing. The run refuses what slips through (`HG_NO_ROUTE`<!-- -->) before it reads anything.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export type RoutedProviders<Ps extends readonly ProviderRef[], R, Bases extends string> = {
    readonly [I in keyof Ps]: Routed<Ps[I], R, Bases>;
};
```
**References:** [ProviderRef](./hopgraph.providerref.md)
